notes.title: Finally released PC version
notes.notes:
Today is the day! We are launching PM on steam for pc version first!

My apology for mac users we still can't sort it out without a mac ver for steam on site to test (getting it at this point is not fiancially possible) 
We have gathered more testers to test on steam client but different bugs come with different users. Getting them all sorted at this point is.... not likely. 
BUT PC ver is released on steam today and I am currently waiting on steam key for our previous KS backers.

 
For mac users, please get the game directly from our site, we have tested it, the game itself is fine on mac: http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/

I am also in process of releasing the artbook digitally, and ordered the final copies for the higher tier backers.

notes.title: Release delayed due to technical errors
notes.notes:
We have a few errors where we are scratching our heads on what happened. 
Here's what we have been trying to get done:

1. Get the mac version running because the original package that was supposed to be for pc/mac/linux turns out only works on PC after review.
2. Get app shortcut to work from steam client, it's not displaying correctly.

Once we get over this hurdle PM should be ready to see the world audience. 

Our apologies for the delay.
